grammar.label: the mandative subjunctive — I suggest that he be told
grammar.form: suggest / recommend / insist / demand / propose + that + subject + base verb
grammar.meaning: a recommendation or requirement, not a statement of fact

explanation.en: After verbs of recommending and requiring, the that-clause uses the base form for every subject: 'We recommend that she attend', 'It is essential that he be present'. The negative is 'that he not be present' — no 'does'.
explanation.uz: Tavsiya va talab bildiruvchi fe'llardan keyin 'that' ergash gapida fe'lning asosiy shakli qo'llanadi: 'We recommend that she attend'. Inkor shakli 'that he not be present' — 'does' ishlatilmaydi.

grammar.positive_example: The committee recommends that the rule be reviewed.
grammar.negative_example: The committee recommends that the rule is reviewed.

l1_notes.uz: Uchinchi shaxsda -s qo'shilmasligi g'alati tuyuladi; buni rasmiy uslubning alohida shakli sifatida o'rganish kerak. AQSh ingliz tilida keng qo'llanadi, Britaniyada ko'pincha 'should' bilan almashtiriladi.

grammar.label: evaluative it-structures — It is vital that, It strikes me as
grammar.form: It + be + adjective/noun + that-clause or to-infinitive; It + verb + object + as
grammar.meaning: puts an evaluation before the thing evaluated

explanation.en: 'It' stands in for a long subject so that the evaluation comes first: 'It is vital that we act' reads better than 'That we act is vital'. Adjectives of importance take the subjunctive; adjectives of likelihood take an ordinary verb: 'It is likely that he will refuse.'
explanation.uz: 'It' uzun egani almashtiradi, shunda baho oldinga chiqadi: 'It is vital that we act'. Muhimlik bildiruvchi sifatlar subjunctive talab qiladi, ehtimollik bildiruvchilari esa oddiy fe'l oladi.

grammar.positive_example: It is vital that every claim be checked before publication.
grammar.negative_example: That every claim is checked before publication is vital.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbek tilida ega tushirib qoldirilishi mumkin, ingliz tilida esa 'it' majburiy — uni tashlab ketish eng keng tarqalgan xato.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: How do I write the last section? Everything I try sounds like an order.

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: It is a recommendation, so write it as one. 'We recommend that the rule be reviewed.'

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: Not in a recommendation. 'Be reviewed'. It is the form the committee expects.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: And if I want it stronger?

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: 'It is essential that the rule be reviewed before September.' Now you have a date as well.

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: A recommendation without a date is a wish. It is advisable to say who acts, too.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: 'We recommend that the registrar review the file.'

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: Good. And put the judgement first: 'It is vital that this be settled' before the detail.
